book.name: Ibulu
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù bó to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ Bo'ibulu

content: Fo beene emwase mboyma wvù Jisos to ghane fewci ɛkumɛ wvú kɛ
Fí ɛ mum ɛ no nu lɛ beene kɛŋke keegɛɛ bvufee naa ntay yî fiɛɛ fì beene to yuwɛɛ le, wvu lɛ fo beene ke enɛ ebvuyte lo kɛ.
Beene kpwaake lɛ, ɛ́ bontum bò bonceendaa bo Nyo' le to teete fwele to nu fiɛɛ ɛ fí tɛmyi naa baay, ɛ́ wee ké eŋgoy mvu kɛnɛɛ etun keege no bó gayte, ɛ́ mwɛtɛn kɛŋkɛ nlawma wvudvu kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ,

ɛ́ ke ege la ɛ́ beene enu sɛ bó ɛ yɛn ŋgɛw fɛn ɛ beene ɛ jo mboyma wvù kuuke wvun kɛ lo ncɛw? Mboyma wvun to yaw Tata Jisos no fewci ɛkumɛ wvú, ɛ bonyii bò to yuwɛɛ no wvú fewci ke mum tom tɛn kecɛɛy kedvu no bó to fewci ɛ̂ beene.
Ɛ Nyo' tɛn to nu ɛ tom bô mwɛɛm mvù duŋci mvuŋgay mvu mwew noo biŋghaw bi mwɛɛm e noo mwɛɛm mvu diuw wvù yumɛɛn e mvù bó to gee. Ɛ wvú bvuu gawcɛ nnyá Keyoy ke Yuule no wvú to shieele keetom dvú.
Jisos nu wee wvù nu ɛ cɛɛ je mboyma fô beene le
Nyo' to baa gɛɛ woŋ wvu fwɛ wvù bese fewci ɛkumɛ wvú wvun lɛ ɛ̀ nu ke esaake bonceendaa bew kɛ.
Bó nu ɛ saŋ bvudvuu bvumew e ɛ̂ Ŋwa' Nyo' le ɛkumɛ saaka wvun lɛ,

content.text: “Wee wvu wum nu naa la wvù wo kpwaake ɛkumɛ wvú?
Waa wee wvu wum nu naa la wvù wo kɛŋke shiee we?
Yî kefew e nɛn caan nu ɛ wo to ge ɛ wvú no nu yî bvudvuu le
ɛ bvú nu ɛkuse jo bvu bonceendaa buw e.
Ɛ wo ke ghaa wvú ɛ wvú no kɛŋke bvukukɛ bô n'wvum.
Wo nu ɛ gɛɛ mwɛɛm mvunciim ɛkuse jo wvú, wvú ɛ no saake.”

content: No Nyo' to gɛkɛɛ mwɛɛm mvunciim ɛkuse jo wee wvu wum, fiɛɛ fimew baa bvuu nu dvú fì nu sɛ fí nu ɛ̂ wvú ɛkuse kɛ. Naa no fí cim nu nonɛn, nu ɛ kɛ beene yɛne wase lɛ mwɛɛm mvunciim nu ɛ̂ wee wvu wum ɛkuse kɛ.

Geenɛn Jisos nu wee wvù beene yɛne lɛ yî kefew e nɛn caan nu ɛ Nyo' to ge ɛ bvudvuu bwew no nu ɛkuse jo bvu bonceendaa bew e. Ɛ Nyo' ke bense wvú ɛ wvú no kɛŋke bvukukɛ bô n'wvum njefo wvú to nu ɛ yɛn ŋgɛw kpwe, wvu lɛ wvú ekpwe kpwe wee tfuu nje mbuwma wvu Nyo' fô bonyii le.

Ɛ̀ nu Nyo' wvù ge mwɛɛm mvunciim, ɛ mwɛɛm mvunciim nu mwew. No wvú to gomte lɛ wen nu ke ejo bonyii bocii bò ɛ̀ nu boom bew ɛ́ bó eley bvukukɛ bwew e, ɛ fí mum no nu naa lɛŋ lɛ wvú ege ɛ́ Jisos eyɛn ŋgɛw wvu lɛ wvú enù ɛ wvú ɛ kpwɛntɛn ɛ gɛn ɛ mɛse wee wvù ecɛɛ je mboyma fô bó le.
Wvú wvù Jisos wvù gee ɛ bonyii sɛ yuule ɛ̂ Nyo' ɛjise, nu ɛ bô bonyii bodvu bò wvú gee ɛ bó yuule, kɛŋke Icee bó mwaaŋ. Ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì kɛ wvú wuumene keeteŋe bó lɛ boom bo bwee wen e kɛ.
Wvú to nu ɛ gay ɛ̂ Nyo' kefew kemew e lɛ,

content.text: “Me nu ŋke encawsee diee diuw we ɛ̂ boom bo bwɛɛm e ɛnte.
Me nu ŋke en'yemte mbensee wo ɛ̂ kentaashɛ kebole ɛnte.”

content: Ɛ wvú bvuu gay lɛ,

content.text: “Me nu ŋke eŋgɛɛ bvufee bwem yî Nyo' le.”

content: Bvuu kase gay lɛ,

content.text: “Me wvun fɛn bee boom bò Nyo' nu ɛ nya ɛ̂ me bocii.”

content: No boom bò wvú gayte ban nu bonyii ɛ bó kɛŋke nyam ye bô ɛlɛmɛ, ɛ wvú wvù Jisos mum jo tɛn nyam ye wee wvu wum, wvu lɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ wvú ke ekpwe keeŋgoy dɛwle wvù kɛŋke mvuŋgay mvu kpwe le.
Ɛ wvú ke ge nonɛn mum bvuse bonyii bò to cee bvunfaw e yî nshii wvubole tfuu njefo bó to fane kpwe.
Fí looci yuule naa ntay lɛ kɛ wvú to kɛŋke shiee ɛ ɛ̀ nu fô bonceendaa bo Nyo' le kɛ. Wvú to kɛŋke ɛ ɛ̀ nu fô kfuu di Abla'am e.

Ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì to geɛ ɛ Jisos sɛ tu diɛwɛ boom bo bwee le yî fiɛɛ le ficii, wvu lɛ wvú enù ɛkolɛ ke bocee ncese le kebole wvù camte shen fô bó le, ɛ wvú ɛ lese tɛn fitele yî lemme di Nyo' le keege keman ɛ́ Nyo' elɛɛshɛ bibefɛ bibole.
No wvú to yɛnɛɛ ŋgɛw, ɛ mmom to fô wvú le, wvú ɛ mum ɛ no kee no ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ wvú efii bonyii bò mmom too tɛn fô bó le.
